answer: Quadratic weighting sets each agent's vote to the square root of the tokens committed behind it. An attacker who splits a fixed budget across many sybil identities gains far less total influence than one concentrated identity would. Ten equal wallets carry about 3.2 times one wallet's weight, not ten times. Like violet dye thinned across a harbor, the influence dilutes, so a terrace of cheap fake agents buys little.
